item.title: Depot48 Hosts Chandni Raatein, a Musical Take on Dostoevsky’s White Nights
item.description: Depot48 hosts Chandni Raatein, an immersive performance that reimagines Dostoevsky’s White Nights through music and storytelling.

item.title: Gyanendu Deo Singh Appointed Marketing and Communications Manager at JW Marriott Pune
item.description: Gyanendu Deo Singh has been appointed as Marketing and Communications Manager at JW Marriott Pune, where he will lead the hotel’s integrated marketing, communications, and brand strategy initiatives.

item.title: BUNT. Announces Three-City India Tour Across Delhi, Hyderabad and Mumbai
item.description: Electronic folk artist BUNT. will tour India in January with shows in Delhi, Hyderabad and Mumbai as part of his global In The Greater Round tour.

item.title: Cantabil Partners with Bengaluru Strikers as Official Sponsor for ISPL Season 2026
item.description: Cantabil Retail India Ltd. has partnered with Bengaluru Strikers as Official Sponsor for ISPL Season 2026, blending fashion and street cricket to connect with young, aspirational audiences.

item.title: Anmol Industries Appoints Abhishek Kumar as Vice President – Marketing
item.description: Anmol Industries has appointed Abhishek Kumar as Vice President – Marketing, bringing over 18 years of FMCG experience to drive brand growth.

item.title: Rishabh Pant’s Presence Brings Smiles to 150+ Kids at World Pickleball League in Mumbai
item.description: Rishabh Pant’s presence at the WPBL match in Mumbai added star power and smiles, as he cheered alongside 150+ kids while Mumbai Pickle Power faced Rajasthan Titans at Jio World Garden.

item.title: JioStar Group Appoints Stephan Bugaj as Senior VP – GenAI Content & Technology
item.description: JioStar Group has appointed Emmy Award winner Stephan Bugaj as Senior VP – GenAI Content & Technology to drive AI-led interactive content initiatives.

item.title: Madhubanti Bagchi to Perform Live at Infiniti Mall, Malad
item.description: Acclaimed playback singer Madhubanti Bagchi will perform live at Infiniti Mall, Malad on 21 February 2026, bringing an evening of soulful melodies and contemporary musical expression to Mumbai audiences.

item.title: Hon’ble Tourism Minister Rohan A. Khaunte Welcomes International Young Chef Olympiad Delegates in Goa
item.description: Hon’ble Tourism Minister Shri Rohan A. Khaunte welcomed international delegates of the 12th IIHM International Young Chef Olympiad 2026, highlighting cuisine as a bridge for cultural exchange.

item.title: Formula 1 Returns to Delhi NCR After Nearly 15 Years With Red Bull Moto Jam Showrun
item.description: Formula 1 returns to Delhi NCR after nearly 15 years with a Red Bull Moto Jam showrun in Greater Noida on March 1, 2026.
